issues.body: The final parenthetical still says this is "the same anonymous-class output-vocabulary gap as WebOnt-I5.5-005". That comparison remains unsupported by the entry's own taxonomy: this case concerns reification/output of an in-profile anonymous hasSelf restriction, while WebOnt-I5.5-005 depends on owl:unionOf/list vocabulary outside EL and is skipped. Both conclusions contain anonymous structure, but the classifier reaches the hasSelf concept here; it does not process the relevant WebOnt union concept.
issues.fix_hint: Remove the final comparison, or explicitly contrast the mechanisms: hasSelf is an in-profile anonymous-restriction reification/output gap; WebOnt-I5.5-005 is blocked because owl:unionOf and its list structure are outside EL and skipped.
issues.title: The hasSelf output gap is still incorrectly equated with WebOnt-I5.5-005

verdict.summary: Round 3's documentation finding remains materially unchanged. The expanded explanation correctly distinguishes the internal CRs3 reasoning from the realiser's anonymous-class output limitation, but its final parenthetical still calls this the same gap as WebOnt-I5.5-005. The surrounding audit itself says WebOnt-I5.5-005 uses owl:unionOf, which is outside EL and skipped, whereas this hasSelf case reaches an in-profile anonymous restriction internally and fails when reifying/outputting that restriction bnode. Because the same minor accuracy issue remains at the same severity, progress is stagnant.
